annotations.title: List versions, stems and shorter cuts

description: Every form a cue can be delivered in: the full-length mix plus, where they exist, timed cutdowns (15, 30, 60 seconds) built for standard ad and promo lengths, alternate mixes such as no-drums, underscore or instrumental for music that sits beneath dialogue, and individual instrument stems for rebalancing a track. A little under half of the catalogue's cues have at least one of these. Each version carries its own listen_url. Relevant when a cue is nearly right but needs to be shorter, quieter under a voice, or stripped back.

ref.description: Any track ref, main mix or one of its versions; the whole family is returned.
